physicalNotes: Radius 0.89 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Rodrigues et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-512 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract): 619,173 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5277 +/- 67 K from Rodrigues et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-512 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
